findings.text: the log the manifest cites as the refactor's gate carries no revision/tree/command header and no bare EXIT= line (it ends at '41 passed, 1 warning in 42.87s'), while the manifest's artifacts line asserts 'EXIT=0' for it, so the exit status of the only arm covering ddb380720 is claimed rather than recorded.

_selects is renamed and documented to take a generate_name subquery clause, but this call passes _claim_seed_cypher(), which returns a full claim statement; the substring restriction check happens to work either way, so the narrowed docstring now misdescribes one of its two callers.

the claim plant's red was produced on a tree still carrying the compose plant because the restore step failed, and one run exited 4 rather than reddening a test, so the re-probe establishes the three guards bite but does not establish each red in isolation; the log discloses both, and the compose and claim plants touch disjoint files so the attribution holds.

justifications.durability: logs/negative-control-repair.log:3,8,27 shows each refactor-sensitive guard red under its own plant, but the claim plant ran on a tree still carrying the compose plant (the log's own corrections block, :31-34) and the finalize plant only reddened once re-aimed at the stable SET block (:22-27), so two of the three reds are attributed by reasoning about file disjointness rather than by an isolated run.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-after.log and logs/gate-baseline.log both carry a revision header and a bare EXIT line and yield 6 failed against 24 failed, so added is 0, but the after arm ran at a767ebcda and predates both delta commits, and the only arm covering the refactor, logs/gate-repair.log, carries no header and no EXIT line.
justifications.fit: the helpers follow their files' idiom and introduce no plan, version or ticket identifier, but tests/standard_names/test_drained_queue_exit.py:245 documents _selects as taking a generate_name clause while :223 passes it the full claim statement _claim_seed_cypher().
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/standard_names/test_compose_batch_isolation.py:132 adds one _run_batch helper that all five callers use, tests/standard_names/test_drained_queue_exit.py:279 routes both the double and the equality assertion through one _restrictions, and tests/standard_names/test_retired_spelling_retry.py:55 reads TransactionDouble's inherited calls log, so the reuse finding the prior review scored 5 is answered without changing an assertion.
justifications.reuse: the prior review's finding at tests/standard_names/test_retired_spelling_retry.py:234 is retired — the local _record_statements is deleted and the guard reads the owner at tests/recording_graph_client.py:32 — and the new tests/standard_names/test_compose_batch_isolation.py:132 _run_batch serves arbitrary raising and counting callables, which the scripted-response fixture at tests/standard_names/conftest.py:1020 cannot.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 853dfee0cf63..4d260f69d6b7 touches exactly the four granted paths and nothing else.
